Frequently asked questions

Answers for suppliers, retailers and hospitality partners.

Learn more about Lamassu Foods, our market coverage and the way we manage sourcing, compliance, storage and distribution.

What does Lamassu Foods do?

Lamassu Foods is a professionally managed food trading and distribution company. We source, import, store and distribute premium food products to retail, wholesale and hospitality businesses throughout Iraq.

Where does Lamassu operate?

Our primary market is Iraq, supported by operational branches in Iraq and the UAE. This regional setup helps us coordinate cross-border trading, supplier relationships and logistics efficiently.

Which business sectors do you serve?

We serve supermarkets, grocery chains, convenience stores, wholesale distributors, hotels, restaurants, dining chains, institutions, catering companies and food service providers.

How do you select food products and suppliers?

We collaborate with reputable international and regional manufacturers. Products are carefully evaluated for safety, freshness, consistency, reliability and long-term value before entering our supply network.

Does Lamassu manage import and regulatory compliance?

Yes. Our team manages import procedures from origin to destination and works to ensure that products meet applicable Iraqi regulatory requirements and recognized food safety standards during transit.

How do you preserve product quality during storage and delivery?

We use structured storage, careful handling and coordinated transport processes designed to preserve product integrity, freshness and quality from warehouse receipt through final delivery.

What is the scale of your local distribution network?

Lamassu's local footprint covers 18 cities and includes 5 sales offices, 2 warehouses, 30 team members, more than 100 clients and a market reach of over 5 million consumers.

How can a brand or business partner with Lamassu?

Manufacturers, suppliers and customers can contact our team at info@lamassu.group to discuss product sourcing, market entry, distribution and long-term collaboration opportunities.
